describe.description: Describe the biomedical monitor: its source, the roster, the nominal band, and whether readings are simulated.

presence.description: Who is aboard: the occupants of every module and what each one is doing now (sleep, rest, light_work, heavy_work, or unknown). The crew's activity is where the cabin's CO2 load comes from; the occupants are who a change of the air, or a test on a volume, exposes.

monitor_start.description: Start monitoring the occupants of the given modules for the duration of a procedure.

monitor_stop.description: Stop the monitoring session and return its record.

report.description: Relay one heart rate reading from a chest strap through a gateway.

state.description: Return every monitored subject with their last rate, their band and their status.

verdict.description: Return one line saying whether there is a reason to abort. It never aborts anything itself.

move.description: Move a subject to a module (scenario control, standing in for a presence sensor).

alarm.title: Raise a critical health alarm
alarm.description: A critical health alarm for one person, raised by someone who saw it. It stays until cleared: a test that exposes the person stops, and no procedure may expose them meanwhile.

alarm_clear.title: Clear a health alarm
alarm_clear.description: The person is safe: the alarm is cleared by someone who says so.
